posts.text: #NFL #ATL #Nazis"Falcons scrub 'Nazi-like' imagery from viral throwback logoIt's throwback week in Atlanta, where the Falcons will pay tribute to a different era as they host the 49ers on Sunday.The design itself isn't sitting well with some fans, though.While the logo is an exact replica of what the franchise used as its primary icon from 1989-2002, the imagery of the logo plastered onto black, gold and cream-colored striping resembled a Nazi insignia in the eyes of some observers.Here's what you need to know about the controversy and whether the Falcons have responded.The Falcons put their throwback logo, which will be worn on this weekend's helmets, on black, gold and cream-colored helmet striping, which some fans believed closely resembled Nazi imagery.The Falcons made the image their profile picture but have since changed the image while leaving the tweet untouched.Atlanta used the logo itself as its primary icon from 1989-2002, but the uniforms were set to be a throwback to the 1966 look that featured a red helmet with gold, white and black stripes, similar to the background of the image the team posted."https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/falcons-scrub-nazi-imagery-viral-210828265.html

posts.text: Mike McCarthy’s key to the Saints Game: “Well, we always talk about ball security. If you look at their past games, their ability to be successful starts with takeaways. We're always fighting to take care of the football and protect it, but we need to own the football on both sides of the ball. We have to maximize each and every one of our possessions and, at a minimum, win the field position battle. It's really about maximizing every series by protecting the football. They've proven they can put points on the board, so we've got to help our defense through ball control, but also with point production.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.
